newsitem.title: USA: Collins & Aikman buys some Perstrop operations.
newsitem.headline: Collins & Aikman buys some Perstrop operations.

text.p: Collins & Aikman Corp. said Wednesday it had acquired Swedish company Perstorp AB's automotive supply and related operations in North America, Britain and Spain for $108 million.
The company said it acquired three Perstorp Components facilities in the United States, two in Canada, one in Mexico, three in the U.K. and one in Spain.
In addition, the two companies entered into a joint venture agreement relating to Perstorp's automotive components supply facilities in Sweden, Belgium and France.
Each company will invest $7.5 million in cash and have a 49.9 percent interest in the joint venture, which will be managed by Collins & Aikman, it said.

The joint venture will purchase the Perstorp components business in Sweden, Belgium and France for $67 million, of which $15 million will be the equity investment and about $52 million of will be debt, the company said.
